name: Snider Consulting Group
tagline: Student-run consulting at the University of Maryland
description: SCG is the University of Maryland's student-run consulting group, solving real problems for campus organizations and nonprofits since 2020, with guidance from EY.

recruiting.note: Set 'open' to true and fill the URLs when the cycle is live. When false, the site shows 'closed_text' and the interest form link if present.

hero._readme: Home hero copy. 'title' must fit on one line at every width (keep it short); 'subhead' is one line from 1024px. The full name stays in the page title, meta description, Open Graph and JSON-LD.
hero.title: Welcome to SCG
hero.subhead: UMD's student-run consulting group, solving real problems since 2020.

images._readme: Paths are relative to the repo root. Anything under assets/placeholders/ is drawn as a labeled gray block. While an '*_is_standin' flag is true, the photo shows a small 'Stand-in photo' tag (dev only); set it to false once a real replacement is in place.
images.community_alt: SCG members in business attire standing together in front of the Robert H. Smith School of Business.

member_employers._readme: Shown on the home page under 'Our members work at…'. Source: the old homepage's 'Our Members Work At…' logo row. Text only until logo files are supplied; add 'logo' paths later if wanted.

timeline._readme: Recruitment timeline steps. Dates are unknown; render 'Dates TBD' until filled. Step names are suggestions modeled on a clear step-by-step pattern; officers must confirm which steps actually exist.

partners.name: EY
partners.blurb: EY sends consultants to lead workshops, pairs each project with consultants, senior managers and partners, and connects members to EY recruiters. SCG has partnered with EY for over four years.

partners.name: Center for Social Value Creation
partners.blurb: Each year SCG collaborates with the Center for Social Value Creation to host the Smith Impact Case Competition. The winning team earns a cash prize and represents UMD at the Seattle Milgard Invitational Case Competition.

partners.name: Ed Snider Center for Enterprise and Markets
partners.blurb: SCG operates in direct affiliation with the Ed Snider Center and is funded by its generous support and by alumni.
